probe: asm7090 2>&1 | head -1; s709 2>&1 | head -1; cat /usr/local/share/ibm709x/README-s709-2.4.4.txt | head -2

build.name: assemble
build.cmd: asm7090 -c 7090 -a -f -p -w -x -d LISP15 -t 'BONNIE-S BIRTHDAY ASSEMBLY' -l lisp15.lst.new -o lisp15.out lisp15.src 2>&1 | tail -1; n=$(grep -c '^ERROR' lisp15.lst.new); echo "assembler_errors=$n"; test -s lisp15.out && test "$n" = 0 && echo ASSEMBLED_0_ERRORS && sha256sum lisp15.out
